# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## Window Title Bar
- Application name: LibreOffice Impress
- Document name: ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx
- Current time: Oct 22 19:35
- System notification bell icon
- Window control buttons: Minimize, Maximize, Close

## Application Menu Bar
- File
- Edit
- View
- Insert
- Format
- Slide
- Slide Show
- Tools
- Window
- Help

## Toolbar
- Standard toolbar icons for file operations, editing, formatting, and slide management
- Icons for: New, Open, Save, Print, Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Find, Zoom, etc.
- Drawing tools: Rectangle, Ellipse, Line, Arrow, Shapes, Text Box, etc.
- Media insertion icons: Image, Video, Audio
- Slide layout and formatting icons
- Text formatting icons: Font size, Bold, Italic, Underline, Font color, Text alignment
- Special characters icon (Ω)
- Link icon
- Pen icon
- Shape and object manipulation icons

## Notification Banner
- Light blue banner with two informational messages:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button
- Close button (X) for the banner

## Slide Navigation Panel
- Located on the left side of the screen
- Shows thumbnails of all 17 slides
- Currently selected slide: Slide 1 (AGENDA)
- Slide thumbnails display titles and content previews
- Scroll bar for navigating through slides

## Main Slide Editing Area
- Current slide: Slide 1 of 17
- Slide title: AGENDA
- Slide content:
  - Bullet points:
    - Background
    - Discussion of the draft Strategic Plan
    - Questions for you
    - Next steps
- Footer: Logo and text "asis&t" with subtitle "Association for Information Science and Technology"

## Properties Panel
- Located on the right side of the screen
- Section: Slide
  - Format: Widescreen (dropdown)
  - Orientation: Landscape (dropdown)
  - Background: None (dropdown) with "Insert Image..." button
  - Master Slide: Title and Content (dropdown)
  - Master Background: Checked
  - Master Objects: Checked
  - Master View: Button
- Section: Layouts
  - Grid of layout thumbnails (12 total)
  - Each thumbnail shows a different slide layout configuration
  - Layouts include variations with title areas, content areas, and different column/row arrangements

## Status Bar
- Slide information: "Slide 1 of 17"
- Slide layout name: "Title and Content"
- Slide position coordinates: "-1.90 / -6.87"
- Slide dimensions: "0.00 x 0.00"
- Language setting: "English (USA)"
- Zoom level: 92%
- Zoom slider with minus and plus buttons

## Desktop Environment
- Left sidebar with application icons:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress (currently active)
  - GIMP
  - File manager
  - App Store
  - Help icon
  - Trash icon
- Bottom left corner: Grid icon for application launcher

## Additional UI Elements
- Window title bar with application name and document name
- Window control buttons in top right corner
- System tray icons in top right corner
- Scroll bars for navigating content
- Toolbars with icons for quick access to common functions
- Properties panel with collapsible sections
- Layout thumbnails with visual previews
- Status bar with contextual information
- Slide thumbnails with previews and navigation controls
